subject.title: feat: add per-agent daily model spend alerts

question: Should OpenClaw support per-agent proactive spend alerts as a core configuration and durable SQLite feature, rather than keeping cost visibility as pull-based usage reporting or an extension-owned capability?
rationale: The implementation is opt-in and evidence-backed, but it introduces a long-lived core config surface and persisted user-visible accounting behavior that code review cannot authorize on its own.

options.title: Sponsor the core feature
options.body: Accept the public configuration and persistent per-agent alert contract, then continue normal merge review with its delivery and accounting semantics documented as supported behavior.

options.title: Keep spend reporting pull-based
options.body: Decline a new core alert contract for now and retain existing on-demand usage reporting while a future owner proposes a narrower extension path.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core feature
recommendation.body: Accept the public configuration and persistent per-agent alert contract, then continue normal merge review with its delivery and accounting semantics documented as supported behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence ties this person to the complete proposal and implementation, while no separately evidenced current-main owner is available in the supplied context.
